description: This Java class defines a service for handling loan buy-down fee amortization events in the Fineract project. It registers multiple event listeners to process amortization when loan events such as loan closure, balance change, transaction creation, or charge-off occur. The class heavily interacts with business event notifier services and domain objects related to loans.

classes.name: LoanCloseListener
classes.description: Listener that triggers buy-down fee amortization processing when a loan is closed.

classes.name: LoanBalanceChangedListener
classes.description: Listener that triggers buy-down fee amortization processing when a loan's balance changes.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeTransactionListener
classes.description: Listener for transactions related to buy-down fee creation on a loan.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeAdjustmentTransactionListener
classes.description: Listener for buy-down fee adjustment transactions.

classes.name: LoanAdjustTransactionListener
classes.description: Listener for loan adjustment transactions involving buy-down fees.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for various loan-related events after construction.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent
methods.description: Handles specific events like loan closure, balance change, transaction creation, charge-offs, etc., triggering amortization processing accordingly in each listener class.
